idea-plugin.name: Keymap Manager
idea-plugin.description:
Keymap Manager finds keyboard shortcuts in your JetBrains keymap that clash — with a macOS system shortcut, or with each other — and lets you fix them in place, without leaving the IDE.

Usage

  1. Open it from Tools → Keymap Manager… or Find Action.
  2. Pick the keymap to inspect from the selector at the top; it defaults to your active one.
  3. Work through the report: Keymap conflicts and Overlaps the IDE doesn't already flag (macOS takes the key), Double-bound keys (one key, several actions), Modified shortcuts (this keymap's own changes), and Inherited Shortcuts (taken from the parent as-is). Click any row for the full explanation.
  4. On a binding: Rebind… (press the new key, or click Suggest… for a free one), Remove…, Revert… to the parent's binding, or Settings… to jump to the platform Keymap page.
  5. Use the gear menu (⚙) next to the keymap selector to Export… / Import… keymaps as XML, or to Duplicate, Rename, or Delete an editable one.
  6. Show modified only, Show Action IDs, and Show Keymap, below the report, narrow or annotate what's shown.
On a German (T1) MacBook Pro keyboard, select the bundled MacBook Pro DE keymap under Settings → Keymap to start from bindings that are actually reachable on that layout.

macOS only. Source: github.com/stefan-huettemann/keymap-manager
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• Conflict report with per-conflict advice, in-place rebind/remove, and XML export.
  • Import a keymap from XML (gear menu → Import…): validates the file, resolves a name clash, and lets you pick a parent when the file's declared parent isn't installed. Imported keymaps can be deleted again.
  • Bundled MacBook Pro DE keymap for the German (T1) MacBook Pro layout.
  • Report wording adapts to the host IDE (IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, GoLand, Android Studio, …).

action.description: Manage keymaps and resolve shortcut conflicts with macOS and within the keymap
